meanings.note: 'вспомни' = remember (that) . Prefix 'вс-' ('up') marks upward or sudden onset of action (stem 'помнить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to remember, to recall', paired with 'вспоминать'.

examples.text: Я этого не хочу. Но вспомни, у тебя сын болеет.
examples.trans: I don't want that. But remember, your son is ill.

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)
meanings.note: Case forms. Core Russian pron meaning 'you (polite or plural)' in everyday speech.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: Высоко ценить = to value highly. Prefix 'вы-' ('out of') marks outward movement or thorough completion (stem 'соко'). Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

Adverb of place. Prefix 'вы-' ('out of') marks outward movement or thorough completion (stem 'соко'). Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.trans: The birds are flying high in the sky.

examples.text: Город высоко ценит вас и вашего мужа.
examples.trans: The city values you and your husband highly.

meanings.note: 'закрывать глаза на' + accusative = to turn a blind eye to

examples.text: Я не буду закрывать на это глаза.

examples.text: А я глаза на это закрывать не буду. Я подниму людей!
examples.trans: Well, I'm not going to close my eyes to this. I'll rally people!

meanings.en: to finish, to end, to complete
meanings.note: + acc. or infinitive. Prefix 'за-' marks beginning an action, covering, or stopping by along the way (stem 'кончить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to finish, to complete', paired with 'заканчивать'.

examples.trans: I want to finish what I started.

examples.text: Был неправ. Простите. Я хочу закончить начатое.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'to her', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

meanings.note: Intransitive reflexive verb. Prefix 'от-' ('away from, off') marks separation, completion, or response (stem 'вернуться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to turn away', paired with 'отворачиваться'.

examples.trans: He turned away from the window.

examples.text: Друзья не отвернулись от него в беде.
examples.trans: Friends did not turn away from him in trouble.

meanings.en: to think it over, to give it a thought

examples.trans: If I were you, I'd think about it.

meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'лучить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to get, to receive', paired with 'получать'.

meanings.note: Попался! = gotcha!. Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'пасться'). meanings.note: Prefix 'про-' indicates movement through, completion, or missing the mark (stem 'снуться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'wake up'.

examples.trans: Vika, are you awake already today?

meanings.note: + accusative. Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'лушать'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to listen', paired with 'послушать'.
the imperative 'слушай' starts a sentence, like 'look, ...'

'Слушаю' = I'm listening. Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'лушать'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to listen', paired with 'послушать'.

examples.trans: Listen, Samson, I've been thinking. Your boss is such an experienced specialist.

meanings.note: Смотреть на + accusative. Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'мотреть'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to look, to watch', paired with 'посмотреть'.

TV, a film. Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'мотреть'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to look, to watch', paired with 'посмотреть'.
